_provenance: Real XBRL figures for two companies that filed real, publicly documented Chapter 11 bankruptcy petitions, fetched live from data.sec.gov on 2026-09-08. Every figure below was cross-checked against the complete raw units.USD array for its tag (not just a filtered/summarized response) after an initial fetch attempt produced one incorrect value (Party City's FY2021 current liabilities), which is itself documented in docs/06_historical_backtest.md as a real methodological finding about the risk of trusting summarized API responses over raw data — exactly the failure mode this project's own code (src/ingestion/xbrl_facts.py) is built to avoid by parsing raw JSON directly rather than through any summarization step.

cases.event_source_note: Widely reported real event; the original New Jersey retailer (CIK 0000886158) — NOT to be confused with a separate, later CIK (0001130713) that Overstock.com took on after acquiring the Bed Bath & Beyond brand name post-bankruptcy, a real entity-resolution gotcha found during this research.
